Command: Men must not destroy the corners of the beard
Summary: One of the appearance laws of Leviticus 19:27: men must not destroy the corners of the beard.
Commandment: Men must not destroy the corners of the beard
Application: TRADITIONAL reading: the corners marked Israel's consecration and separated its mourning and appearance from neighbouring pagan customs. Scripture states the prohibition without a separate reason.
